description.name: Linked Materia Mode (Lightning, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning]/[Attach Earth] after using a Lightning/Earth ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rude
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Grand Spark (0~2), removed after using Apex Grand Spark two times

description.name: Apex Grand Spark Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Grand Spark level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rude]

description.name: Apex Grand Spark Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Grand Spark level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Rude]
